description: Clears sources.architectures.repository, which is what makes DirectoryFreshness render the plain-text 'cncf/architecture' arm of its link ternary (src/components/MemberDirectory/DirectoryFreshness.js line 44) instead of the anchor at src/components/MemberDirectory/DirectoryFreshness.js:40. That arm needs the architectures sentence to render -- metrics.generatedAt present -- while the repository URL is absent, so it cannot go in the variant build, which clears generatedAt and drops the sentence entirely, nor in the ordinary coverage build, whose anchor is the one tests/e2e/member-directory-freshness.spec.js asserts. One build cannot hold both shapes, which is why the fixture mechanism takes a directory per build rather than a fixed second one. metrics.generatedAt is deliberately left present here: with it cleared this build would cover nothing the variant does not. sources.architectures.revision is cleared alongside repository so the overlay describes a metrics file collected without any upstream checkout at all; nothing under src/ reads revision any more (the /architectures sync-status line that did was retired with the cncf/architecture import), so the field costs this build no coverage.
